import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> graph;
    static int[] level, it;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph.get(u).add(new Edge(v, graph.get(v).size(), cap));
        graph.get(v).add(new Edge(u, graph.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph.get(v)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (int i = it[v]; i < graph.get(v).size(); i++) {
            Edge e = graph.get(v).get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
                int d = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.cap -= d;
                    graph.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
                    return d;
                }
            }
            it[v]++;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            while (true) {
                int f = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
                if (f == 0) break;
                flow += f;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int dt = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[][] a = new int[n][n];
        int[][] b = new int[n][n];
        boolean[][] red = new boolean[n][n];
        boolean[][] block = new boolean[n][n];

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c == 'Y') block[x][y] = true;
                else if (c == 'Z') red[x][y] = true;
                else a[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') b[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }

        int m = n * n;
        int[][] dis = new int[m][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], 1000000000);
            dis[i][i] = 0;
        }

        int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (block[x][y] || red[x][y]) continue;
                int id = x * n + y;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int i = x + dx[d];
                    int j = y + dy[d];
                    if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j]) {
                        dis[id][i * n + j] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                if (dis[i][k] == 1000000000) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (dis[k][j] == 1000000000) continue;
                    if (dis[i][k] + dis[k][j] < dis[i][j]) {
                        dis[i][j] = dis[i][k] + dis[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dred = new int[m];
        Arrays.fill(dred, 1000000000);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red[i][j]) {
                    dred[i * n + j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            int id = x * n + y;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int i = x + dx[d];
                int j = y + dy[d];
                int nid = i * n + j;
                if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] && dred[nid] > 1000000000) {
                    dred[nid] = dred[id] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int source = 2 * m;
        int sink = 2 * m + 1;
        graph = new ArrayList<>(2 * m + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * m + 2; i++) {
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        level = new int[2 * m + 2];
        it = new int[2 * m + 2];

        boolean[] seen = new boolean[m];
        for (int cur = 0; cur < m; cur++) {
            int sx = cur / n;
            int sy = cur % n;
            if (block[sx][sy] || red[sx][sy]) continue;
            Arrays.fill(seen, false);
            Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
            q2.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
            seen[cur] = true;
            while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                int[] p = q2.poll();
                int x = p[0], y = p[1];
                int id = x * n + y;
                if (dis[cur][id] <= dt) {
                    addEdge(cur * 2, id * 2 + 1, 1000);
                }
                if (dis[cur][id] == dred[id]) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int i = x + dx[d];
                    int j = y + dy[d];
                    int nid = i * n + j;
                    if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] &&
                        dis[cur][nid] <= dred[nid] && dis[cur][nid] <= dt &&
                        dis[cur][nid] > dis[cur][id] && !seen[nid]) {
                        seen[nid] = true;
                        q2.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                addEdge(source, (i * n + j) * 2, a[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                addEdge((i * n + j) * 2 + 1, sink, b[i][j]);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow(source, sink));
    }
}
